mind-poisoning.name: mind_poisoning
mind-poisoning.description: BETA CANDIDATE 0.1.25: conservative affinity updates from identity-checked NPC acknowledgements and Player input, with optional single-type judgments, actor-owned reflection, default-off NPC ACK overhearing, canonical Player handling, sentinel exclusion, and a read-only dashboard. Version 0.1.25 adds preserve-mode source-ID fencing and mismatched-scope baselining while leaving disabled-policy behavior unchanged. The native compatibility fixture passed against CHIM 3.5.1; provider, installed-package, full ACK runtime, and gameplay behavior remain unverified. Standard release classification supports topic discovery and does not promote maturity.
